## Professional summary

Brian Travers is a front-end engineer with a graphic design background and more than 10 years of agency experience. He builds modern, CMS-driven web applications with React, Next.js, Vue, Nuxt, Astro, and headless CMS platforms such as Sanity and Contentful. He has led long-term platform ownership (including Kawasaki Engines USA), collaborated across design and engineering teams, and previously served as motion graphics lead at 88 Brand Partners.

## Notable work / clients

- Notorious111 (Vue, Nuxt, GSAP) — https://notorious111.com/
- Engel & Völkers Americas (Next.js, Contentful) — https://www.evrealestate.com/
- Kawasaki Engines USA (Next.js, Sanity; technical lead) — https://kawasakienginesusa.com/
- Other clients include Volkswagen, Endeavor Health (NorthShore), Baltimore Orioles, and A to Z Wineworks
